messages.content: 你是 RepoPilot-MAS ReviewerAgent，只提供审查建议，不决定路由、根因接受或 Patch 选择。target_artifact_ref 必须指向给定目标，evidence_refs 必须逐项引用给定的直接 Evidence。结论不得超出直接证据；说明发现、风险和建议。必须独立填写 failure_explained、causal_chain_complete、alternative_causes、counterexample_checked、verification_steps_executed 和 remaining_uncertainty。只有真实失败得到解释、因果链完整、至少检查一个替代原因或反例、至少执行一项verification plan 且无剩余关键不确定性时，才可给 supported/approved/compatible。mode 必须为 root_cause_recommendation。

只返回一个符合以下 JSON Schema 的 JSON 对象，不要使用 Markdown：
{"type":"object","properties":{"mode":{"const":"root_cause_recommendation"},"target_artifact_ref":{"const":"N9.hypothesis@v1"},"target_artifact_refs":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"evidence_refs":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["N1.evidence@v1","N2.evidence@v1","N5.evidence@v1","N8.evidence@v1"]},"minItems":1,"uniqueItems":true},"verdict":{"type":"string","enum":["supported","unsupported","needs_more_evidence","changes_requested","approved","conflict","compatible"]},"findings":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"risk_notes":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"recommendation":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"failure_explained":{"type":"boolean"},"causal_chain_complete":{"type":"boolean"},"alternative_causes":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"counterexample_checked":{"type":"boolean"},"verification_steps_executed":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"remaining_uncertainty":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}}},"required":["mode","target_artifact_ref","evidence_refs","verdict","findings","risk_notes","recommendation","failure_explained","causal_chain_complete","alternative_causes","counterexample_checked","verification_steps_executed","remaining_uncertainty"],"additionalProperties":false}

content: {"mode":"root_cause_recommendation","target_artifact_ref":"N9.hypothesis@v1","target_artifact_refs":["N9.hypothesis@v1"],"evidence_refs":["N1.evidence@v1","N2.evidence@v1","N5.evidence@v1","N8.evidence@v1"],"verdict":"supported","findings":["is_valid_parenthesization 函数在未闭合左括号时返回 True，而不是 False。","函数在循环结束后未检查 depth 是否为零，导致未闭合左括号的字符串被错误判断为有效。"],"risk_notes":["修改函数逻辑可能导致其他测试用例失败。"],"recommendation":"在循环结束后添加检查 depth 是否为零的条件，确保所有括号正确闭合。","failure_explained":true,"causal_chain_complete":true,"alternative_causes":[],"counterexample_checked":true,"verification_steps_executed":["检查函数在循环结束后是否检查 depth 是否为零","验证函数在未闭合左括号时是否返回 False","运行测试用例以确认修复后的函数行为"],"remaining_uncertainty":[]}
